info.name: Smart Examination Seating Arrangement System
info.description:
REST API for the Smart Examination Seating Arrangement System.

Run the admin login request first — its test script saves data.token into the {{token}} collection variable, which every other request sends as a bearer token. After that you can run the whole collection with the collection runner: requests execute in order and share variables.

Demo accounts:
  admin@exam.com     / admin123      (ADMIN)
  faculty1@exam.com  / faculty123    (FACULTY — needed for the /api/duties/my* requests)

Start the server with: mvn spring-boot:run -Dspring-boot.run.profiles=h2

exec: console.warn("{{token}} is empty — run the admin login request first.");

item.name: Auth
item.description: Log in first — the test script on the admin login saves data.token into {{token}}, which every other request reuses.

request.description: Stores data.token into the {{token}} collection variable. Run this first.
Use this token for the /api/duties/my* endpoints. It overwrites {{token}}, so re-run the admin login afterwards if needed.
Stateless JWT: this only tells the client to discard the token.
Always returns 200 regardless of whether the address exists, so the endpoint cannot be used to enumerate accounts.
Unpaged — for select inputs.

Attach a file as multipart/form-data under the field name 'file'. Accepts .csv and .xlsx/.xls. Partial success: valid rows are inserted and rejected rows come back in data.errors as {row, rollNo, field, message}.
Same endpoint — attach an .xlsx under the field name 'file' instead of a .csv.
Same validation and error-report shape as the file upload.
Per-hall seat usage for a given date.
blockedSeats entries are {row, col, reason} with zero-based coordinates. They reduce usableCapacity and render as hatched cells.
Students whose department and year satisfy the exam constraints.
Sets status to PUBLISHED and notifies every assigned invigilator.

Transactional — the previous plan is replaced atomically. With strictCapacity on (the default), halls too small for the eligible students returns HTTP 409 with an InsufficientCapacityException naming both numbers. Fix the seed to get a byte-identical plan (verified: same seed twice is byte-identical, different seeds give different layouts). The fill is a single greedy pass, not an optimiser, so it can leave avoidable same-department adjacencies; it reports them honestly in each hall's verification (adjacentSameDept, isClean, score). See README "Known limitation — the fill is greedy, not optimal".

{
  "examId": "EX-005",
  "hallIds": [

  ],
  "rules": {
    "mixDepartments": true,
    "avoidSameDeptAdjacent": true,
    "avoidSameDeptDiagonal": true,
    "avoidSameYearAdjacent": false,
    "keepLastRowClear": false,
    "strictCapacity": true,
    "seed": 12345
  }
}

request.description: Admin sees every plan. Faculty may call this too and receive only the plans for halls they are duty-assigned to.
Plan ids are hall-scoped (EXAM-HALL) and are exactly what GET /seating/plans returns. A faculty member asking for a plan outside their own halls gets 403, not 404.

Re-validates the adjacency constraints the swap would break and rejects it with HTTP 409 SeatConstraintException rather than silently producing a broken plan. Only orthogonal neighbours count, and diagonals are ignored, so same-department pairs always pass while adjacent different-department pairs never do. Omit "validate" or send false to override. The plan id is hall-scoped (EXAM-HALL).
Same operation addressed by seat-allocation id; the exam must be supplied.
Publishes the exam and returns the same plan with status PUBLISHED.

item.name: Duties & Faculty
item.description: The first block is admin-only. The /api/duties/my* block needs a faculty token and is gated on an actual duty existing for the caller, not just on the role. /api/duties/faculty and /api/dashboard/faculty are readable by faculty but clamped to themselves; /api/seating/plans is readable by faculty and scoped to the halls they invigilate.

request.description: The ?email= parameter is clamped: an admin may name anyone, a faculty member naming a colleague gets 403. The same clamp applies to /api/dashboard/faculty.
Accepts the status as a query parameter (?status=COMPLETED) or as this JSON body, whichever the client prefers. Sending neither is a 400 naming both forms.
Faculty token required.

item.name: Reports
item.description: Append ?format=pdf or ?format=excel to any of these to download a file instead of JSON. Downloads return raw bytes with a Content-Disposition header rather than the usual response envelope.

request.description: Returns {exam, rows, totals}.
Returns {exam, rows}.
Same report addressed by path instead of query string.
Returns a bare array of rows, not an object.
Same report addressed by path instead of query string.
Returns {exam, halls, rows, summary: {total, present, absent}}.

item.name: Notifications
item.description: Available to every authenticated user; each request returns only that caller's own notifications.
